candidates.noMatches: No compatible models match this search.

editor.defaultDescription: Used when no rule matches or evaluation fails.

connections.title: Connected Model Topology
connections.description: External endpoints are provider-wide and affect every model from that provider.
connections.empty: Select candidate models to review their connections.

strategy.title: Routing Strategy
strategy.description: Choose how the router selects a candidate. Switching modes keeps the other configuration intact.
strategy.rulesDescription: Deterministic conditions and optional model-backed signals. First match wins.
strategy.naturalDescription: A routing model reads your instruction and chooses one candidate directly.
strategy.descriptionNew: Pick the mechanism that decides which model handles each request.
strategy.rulesDescriptionNew: Pattern-based rules with optional classifier signals - first match wins.
strategy.naturalDescriptionNew: An LLM model reads your instruction and picks the right candidate for each request.

natural.title: Natural-language router
natural.description: The selected model must return exactly one candidate. Invalid output falls back to the default model.
natural.modelHint: Usually a small, fast chat model.
natural.instructionHint: Describe clearly when each candidate should be selected.
natural.placeholder: Use the fast model for everyday questions. Use the larger model for difficult reasoning, coding, or long context.

classifiers.title: Classifiers
classifiers.description: Optional model-backed signals evaluated once per request.
classifiers.empty: No classifiers. Deterministic rules need none.
classifiers.promptPlaceholder: Choose SAFE for routine requests and RISKY for requests that could cause external side effects.
classifiers.descriptionNew: Model-scored signals you can reference inside your rules.

rules.title: Ordered Rules
rules.description: First matching rule wins. The default model handles the remainder.
rules.required: At least one rule is required.
rules.descriptionNew: Evaluated top to bottom - the first match wins, everything else falls back to the default.
rules.graphAppears: The graph editor will appear here.

loadPolicy.title: Load router policy?
loadPolicy.message: The full router policy finished loading after you started editing. Loading it now will discard the changes currently in the editor.

loadCached.title: Load cached router policy?
loadCached.message: The server detail request failed, but cached router data is available. Loading it will discard the changes currently in the editor.

switch.title: Switch routing strategy?
switch.toNatural: Switching to the Natural-language router will clear the current ordered rules and classifiers. This cannot be undone.
switch.toRules: Switching to Ordered rules will clear the current routing model and instruction. This cannot be undone.

new.title: Start a new router?
new.message: This will discard the unsaved routing work currently in the editor. Saved routers are not affected.

loadAnother.title: Load another router?
loadAnother.message: Loading a saved router will discard the unsaved changes currently in the editor.

import.title: Import router JSON?
import.message: Importing this file will replace the unsaved changes currently in the editor.

delete.title: Delete router?
delete.message: Delete {{name}}? This removes the saved router definition from Lemonade.
delete.messageDirty: Delete {{name}}? This removes the saved router definition from Lemonade. Unsaved edits in this editor will also be discarded.

close.title: Close router editor?
close.message: Closing now will discard the unsaved changes currently in the editor.
